method: web tool opened upstream qt/qtbase 5.15 source; selected human paraphrases, not full source downloads or target provider inspection

sources.paraphrase: The upstream private header begins with revision and class-name fields, then class-info count/data, method count/data, further count/data pairs, flags and signal count. Its commentary associates revision7 with Qt5.0 and revision8 with a later enum-format addition. This is documentary format context only.

The upstream method matcher reads argument count at row+1, resolves the name using row0 and string data, and checks parameter types for each argument. Its local search derives a row using the method-data offset plus five times the local index and returns the matching local index. This supports the selected revision7-compatible interpretation without proving the target loader/provider or executing matching.

limits: Not the original target headers, exact target Qt release or effective loaded provider.
Original target bytes/relocations are independently required; modern upstream context cannot replace them.
Earlier official v5.0.0/5.3 retrieval attempts returned unavailable/cache-miss; no bytes/hash from those absent pages claimed.
No provider body/target code execution, network to target, or complete Qt connection semantic proof.
